transcript.text: Hey there! I'm so happy we're hanging out again to practice your German! Ready for a quick review? Let's see if you remember: what do we call a cup in German? Think back to last time!
No worries! It's totally fine. It's die Tasse. Can you say that with me? Die Tasse. Now, what's that patterned thing behind you? Is that a mousepad? [interrupted]
Of course! What's on your mind? You can ask me anything, in English or even in Darija if you prefer! What are you curious about?
